newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech cable TV exceeds expectations.
newsitem.headline: Ameritech cable TV exceeds expectations.

text.p: Ameritech Corp said Thursday its entrance in the cable television market in 1996 through the Americast consortium has far exceeded its expectations.
Americast has 27 franchises and is providing cable television in 17 communities, according to Richard Notebaert, chairman and chief executive of Ameritech.
"It was a great experience for us and far exceeded our expectations," Notebaert said in a monthly meeting with reporters. "It has exceeded our market share expectations and our growth expectations."
Notebaert declined to give details on Ameritech's expectations for Americast, as the service is still new.
Americast, a consortium consisting of Ameritech, BellSouth Corp, GTE Corp, SBC Communications, Southern New England Telecommunications Corp and Walt Disney Co, launched its first service in May 1996.
